scope: Recovered immutable binary, render asset, launcher, license and evidence payload; not an assembled server or a private-world updater.

path_rules.files_path: Output path relative to runtime payload root; default source is runtime/functional-r4/{path}.
path_rules.source_repo_path: Optional repository-root-relative source for an unsplit file.
path_rules.parts_path: Repository-root-relative chunk input; reconstruct in listed order and verify every chunk plus full reconstructed bytes.
path_rules.artwork: Optional separate artwork output record with path,bytes,sha256 and source_repo_path or parts. It is not engine/launcher source.

provenance.source_notice: The preserved older source tree does not reproduce the recovered 1.0.3 binary. Recorded source digests do not supply missing source bytes. The optional bridge has corresponding source under licenses/.
provenance.private_owner_world_profile: sanitized public world 2026-11-23 with local workshop; current private Daytona world not included

verification.payload_hashes: Read directly from recovered original files; full-file hashes must remain identical after chunk reconstruction.
verification.historical_runtime: Actual Linux Paper startup, ordinary authentication, pack delivery and clean stop recorded in the preserved owner-package verification; this payload was not newly booted as an assembled server.

daytona_connector.scope: Synthetic API/Minecraft responses and processes; credential handling, request restrictions, readiness failures, SSH establishment race and owned-process cleanup. No live credentials/network.

assembly.release_status: Conditional on a successful workflow; this manifest does not claim a GitHub Release already exists.

launch_modes.same_existing_daytona: Repository-root Start-Daytona.bat creates an SSH forward to an existing running server; it does not deploy, start, restart or overwrite Daytona.
launch_modes.separate_local_world: Start-GTM-Java-Only.bat is operational only inside the complete separately saved portable owner package; it starts that public-snapshot local copy.

not_in_this_payload: complete Paper or Windows Java installation
installation_limits: Never blindly overlay local workshop configuration, properties, prices, permissions, sites or world data onto an existing server.
Inspect a stopped coherent target copy and preserve complete original state before replacing the core or allowing first-boot migrations.

Preserve online-mode, UUIDs, credentials, permissions, Floodgate/proxy identity and keys; SimpleLogin/AuthMe/LoginSecurity require deliberate migration because the built-in provider refuses coexistence.
Optional Bedrock bridge targets pinned Geyser 2.12.1 build1308; inspect target version compatibility.
Resource-pack URL/bind and integrity manifest must match actual reviewed target configuration.
Rollback must use coherent stopped state and must not overwrite later player progress.
Functional models may need property, compatible backing blocks, supplies or commissioned routes; full city/campaign not complete.
